title: Home Mortgage Loans: underwriting decisions, note rate, closing disbursement, first installment and escrow at origination
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: underwriting decisions, note rate, closing disbursement, first installment and escrow at origination

This policy governs how a Home Mortgage Loans application is approved, priced and closed, when the first installment falls due, and whether an escrow account is required. It applies from the recorded application through closing and funding.

## Policy clauses

1. **Underwriting.** Underwriting approves a loan only within the program's smallest and largest loan amount, largest loan-to-value ratio, lowest credit score, highest debt-to-income ratio and eligible occupancy types. These are credit decisions made by the underwriting system, never by the agent.
2. **Note rate.** The note rate is the program's par rate, locked for the program's rate-lock period.
3. **Funding.** The loan funds at closing with one disbursement of the loan proceeds, which includes any upfront insurance premium the program finances. When the loan closes and funds, PCB begins servicing it and the loan moves from applied to active status.
4. **First installment.** The first installment is due on the program's installment due day of the month that falls the program's set number of months after the funding month.
5. **Escrow.** Escrow is required when the original loan-to-value ratio exceeds the program's escrow threshold, or always where the program sets escrow as always required. Otherwise the borrower may waive escrow by paying the program's escrow waiver fee, a percent of the loan, at closing.

## Escrow decision table

| Program setting | Original loan-to-value ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Escrow always required | Any | Escrow required |
| Threshold set | Exceeds the threshold | Escrow required |
| Threshold set | Equal to or below the threshold | The borrower may waive escrow by paying the waiver fee at closing |

## Condition, judgement and action

| Stage | What is judged | By whom or on what basis |
|---|---|---|
| Approval | Amount range, loan-to-value, credit score, debt-to-income, occupancy | The underwriting system, never the agent |
| Pricing | Note rate | The program's par rate, held for the lock period |
| Closing | Amount disbursed | One disbursement, including any financed upfront premium |
| Servicing start | First due date | The due day of the month the set number of months after the funding month |

## Basis Q&A

- **May the agent approve an application that is just outside a program's debt-to-income limit?** No. Approval is a credit decision of the underwriting system, never of the agent.
- **Is the loan disbursed in stages?** No. It funds at closing with one disbursement.
- **Does the disbursement include the financed upfront premium?** Yes, where the program finances an upfront premium, that premium is part of the single closing disbursement.
- **Can escrow be waived on a program where escrow is always required?** No. A waiver is available only in the "otherwise" case, where escrow is not required.
